# Booth Design Karachi

> Booth Design Karachi is an exhibition booth company in PECHS, Karachi, Pakistan. It designs, builds and installs exhibition stalls, booths, custom stands, kiosks and photo booths, and offers local services in Lahore and Islamabad. Exhibition stall projects start from PKR 30,000.

Booth Design Karachi runs design, fabrication, installation and dismantling as one process, for both raw-space and shell-scheme exhibition stands. It builds, rents and sells kiosks (retail, mall and food kiosks in aluminium, wood, iron and foldable builds) and photo booths.

## Key facts

- Name: Booth Design Karachi
- Services: exhibition stall design, exhibition stall fabrication, custom exhibition stands, kiosk fabrication (build, rent, buy), photo booths (rent, build, buy)
- Starting price: exhibition stall projects start from PKR 30,000; the final price depends on space type, size, materials, branding and timeline
- Service area: Karachi (primary); local services in Lahore and Islamabad
- Office: Office 505, 5th Floor, Business Avenue Building, Shahrah-e-Faisal, Block 6, PECHS, Karachi, Pakistan
- Phone / WhatsApp: +92 371 2389089 (0371 2389089)
- Email: share@boothdesignkarachi.com
- Hours: Monday to Sunday, 09:00 AM to 09:00 PM
- Primary venue focus: Expo Centre Karachi, Main University Road, Gulshan-e-Iqbal
- Typical planning lead time: start design 6-8 weeks before the exhibition

## Services

- [Exhibition Stall Designer in Karachi](https://boothdesignkarachi.com/exhibition-booth-stall-design.html): Layout, 3D concept and branding for shell-scheme and raw-space stands.
- [Stall Fabricator in Karachi](https://boothdesignkarachi.com/exhibition-stall-fabrication-karachi.html): Building, on-site installation and dismantling of exhibition stalls and booths.
- [Exhibition Stand Builders in Karachi](https://boothdesignkarachi.com/custom-exhibition-stands.html): Bespoke builds for raw space, double-storey and irregular footprints.
- [Kiosk Fabrication in Karachi](https://boothdesignkarachi.com/kiosk-design.html): Retail, mall and food kiosks to build, rent or buy.
- [Photo Booth in Karachi](https://boothdesignkarachi.com/photo-booth-karachi.html): Photo booths to rent, build or buy for exhibitions, events and brand activations.
- [Exhibition Stand Builders in Pakistan](https://boothdesignkarachi.com/exhibition-stand-builders-pakistan.html): Local stand design, fabrication and installation in Lahore and Islamabad.
- [All services](https://boothdesignkarachi.com/services.html): How the services fit together.
